# 3 · Topic Points (viewpoint → basis → disagreement, with proposer)

**T1 — SMT / PCB build & shipment**
- Viewpoint (Factory presenter): 30 pcs complete on 11/23, ship 10 ASAP, balance flows 11/28 → 12/10 → 12/11. Basis: current material/test schedule.
- Constraint raised (Presenter, relaying **Sarah**): internal **solder photos** required before the pieces can be considered clean. No disagreement recorded; **photo scope/quantity [TBC]**.

**T2 — Fixture & equipment buy-off**
- Viewpoint (Presenter): battery assembly fixture and carrier **bought off**; E-equipment buy-off complete with **no test difference**. Basis: buy-off records (not attached).
- Open: **PCB test not complete**; check to be posted **11/25**. Battery-assembly fixture tracking date **11/30 vs "next Monday"** — unreconciled.

**T3 — Solar panel readiness**
- Viewpoint (Presenter): TJ confirmed → preparation may start; **color = Gray 1**, therefore **no extra purchase**. Basis: TJ confirmation (email/record not attached).
- Counter-fact (Presenter): **panel data only partially received**; **Gushan deliverable outstanding**; **fixture-control vendor silent**. Brian + presenter escalating; **kept open, not closed**.

**T4 — DP420 running change (S56 → DP420)**
- Viewpoint (Customer lead): **do not switch immediately** — consume S56, cut in per forecast. Basis: stock consumption / running-change discipline.
- Viewpoint (Customer lead): **pilot before rollout** — 30 pcs first, extend only if clean; first round **FAI + [3 or 30] pcs**, then customer approval → production. Basis: risk of unknown issues even after buy-off (*"虽然我们做完…问题，但是有可能你跑一跑…所以你先跑一个小量"*).
- **Unresolved discrepancy:** pilot **30 pcs** vs **FAI + 3 pcs**. Also **King's approval is assumed, not confirmed** (*"I thought King have approve"*).

**T5 — Cure-time / line monitoring**
- Viewpoint ("Che" [TBC]): DP420 **cures faster**, so the S56 habit is unsafe. S56 → **2-hourly check**; DP420 → **IE + QE on the line for the first week**. Basis: process-practice difference and faster cure. No dissent recorded; the monitored parameter name is **[TBC]**.

**T6 — MES 8-hour control & charging rig / stations**
- Fact (Presenter): **email confirmation, 8 hours for "Y-A" module**; **DP420 not yet verified**.
- Question (Customer lead): **when can the two stations go live?** Current workaround = **computer borrowed from another project** (temporary, not a solution).
- Answer (Customer lead): **verify inline once the rig arrives ("next Monday"), demonstrate control on the real system/process to Brian, then buy off**. Implementation date **not committed**.

**T7 — PVT Plus "Y" allocation & verification plan**
- Viewpoint (Presenter): 13 pcs done today; last item pushed to the **next build**; this build **ships direct to US**; **10 pcs retained for TJ**; correlation + cross-section planned.
- Challenge (Brian): **the tester has not arrived** — sequencing must be explicit. Presenter: cross-section / stress / fixture work can start now, **GR&R last (last 3 days)**.
- Agreement: **joint re-planning session immediately after the meeting**, dates published, report shared for review, WeChat updated. **Allocation numbers remain garbled → [TBC].**

**T8 — Report closures**
- **SMT report:** presenter says complete; **Brian refuses closure without new results** (explicit dissent, retained).
- **Taco solar panel QCP:** comment requested, **no response captured**.
- **Taco dispense:** work ongoing, report item to be revised; **Jason's feedback / closure status unknown**.

**T9 — Rework / NG control (8D items 4 & 5)**
- Occurrence cause (Quality presenter): **process never required recording** → SOP silent → operator did not record → **no scan/system control** on **[17M]/SN**. Earlier fix proposal **rejected**; system control now to be installed.
- Escape cause (Quality presenter): **reworked vs normal units not separated**, both sent to inspection → inspectors could not tell → escape.
- Customer reframing: the real gap is **no control and no defined rework process/method**, not just missing records.
- **Open disagreement/blocker:** **who owns the NG definition and judgement** — email sent, **no answer**; NG identification standard only **proposed**, to be discussed further.
